name: Scoriaceous-Gibber
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near frozen methane lakes.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Instruments disagree about the exotic matter deposit: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
